ctx.x: well known, you know, as a writer and as a playing musician. Strange as it may seem, you know there are not that many original, like. In Kansas City you had Thamon Hayes and start naming off a whole slew of musicians that came from there.
Yeah, it wasn't, I guess, until after the War there were a lot of guys came out of Detroit like Milt Jackson and Kenny Burrell and...
And they were the fore...they were not the forerunners, they were the aftermath of the exodus, shall we say.
